name: Byteflows Travel & Hotel Booking
author: Byteflows

sections.description:
Byteflows Travel & Hotel Booking is the easiest way to turn WordPress into a complete travel & hotel booking website.

Whether you run a tour operator business, a travel agency, an adventure company, or a hotel and resort, Byteflows gives you everything you need to showcase trips and rooms, take reservations online, and manage every booking — all from your WordPress dashboard, with a clean, fully responsive, mobile-ready design.

Publish beautiful trip packages with day-by-day itineraries and hotels with real room types, then let visitors search, compare, wishlist, review and book in a few taps. A powerful step-by-step booking engine handles availability, traveler details and secure server-side price validation, while manual / bank-transfer checkout lets you start accepting bookings on day one — no payment account required.

Need online card payments, coupons, printable invoices, priced pickup points, WhatsApp booking alerts or a built-in AI travel assistant? The optional Byteflows Travel & Hotel Booking Pro add-on unlocks them all and installs right alongside this free plugin — the extra options simply appear, with nothing to migrate.

🌍 What Makes Byteflows the Perfect Travel Booking Plugin?

Byteflows is built specifically for the travel and hospitality business — not a generic store plugin bent into shape. Every feature is designed around how people actually browse and book trips and stays.

✈️ Powerful Trip & Tour Packages
Create unlimited trips and tours with a dedicated, purpose-built editor. Add day-by-day itineraries, multiple pricing tiers, rich image galleries, an interactive location map, trip highlights, difficulty and activity types, and a FAQ section — everything a traveler needs to decide, on one gorgeous page.

🏨 Complete Hotel & Room Management
Publish hotels and resorts with individual room types, amenities and facilities, star ratings, photo galleries, location maps and availability. Give guests a clear, professional overview and a frictionless path from browsing to booking.

🧭 Smart Step-by-Step Booking Engine
A guided, AJAX-powered booking flow that feels effortless: pick dates, check real-time availability, choose travelers and rooms, enter details and confirm. Prices are always validated on the server, so totals can’t be tampered with — bookings you can trust.

💳 Manual / Bank Transfer Checkout (Built In)
Start taking bookings immediately with configurable bank-transfer instructions — no gateway account, no monthly fees. Perfect for agencies that collect deposits or payments offline. (Add Stripe, PayPal and Razorpay any time with Pro.)

🔎 Advanced Search + Drag-and-Drop Form Builder
Give visitors an instant, AJAX-powered search with filters for destination, activity, date and budget. Then design exactly the search experience you want with the built-in drag-and-drop search-form builder — horizontal or vertical, on any page.

❤️ Wishlist & Side-by-Side Compare
Let visitors save their favorite trips and hotels to a wishlist and compare options side by side, so they can make confident decisions and come back to book.

⭐ Reviews & Ratings
Build trust with an integrated review and star-rating system, complete with moderation, so genuine guest feedback drives more bookings.

📊 Booking Manager & Revenue Reports
Manage every reservation from a dedicated dashboard with a slide-in booking detail drawer, status controls and clear revenue reports — see how your business is performing at a glance.

📧 Automated Email Notifications
Keep customers informed automatically with booking confirmation and status-update emails, so no one is ever left wondering.

🧩 Gutenberg Blocks & Elementor Widgets
Build pages visually. Native Gutenberg blocks and matching Elementor widgets let you drop trip grids, hotel grids, destinations, search forms and booking forms anywhere — each with live style controls (see the full list below).

🚀 Built for Performance, SEO & Developers
Automatic schema markup gives trips and hotels rich, SEO-friendly structured data. A full REST API powers headless and mobile builds. And a completely re-skinnable, CSS-variable-driven design fits any theme without touching plugin code.

🎁 One-Click Demo Content
Not sure where to start? Import ready-made sample trips and hotels with a single click and see the whole platform in action instantly. Demo images ship inside the plugin — nothing is downloaded from anywhere.

🧩 Gutenberg Blocks & Elementor Widgets

Byteflows ships with 5 native page-builder elements, available both as Gutenberg blocks (under the “Byteflows Travel” category) and as matching Elementor widgets. Every element renders live in the editor and shares a full Style panel — grid gap, card radius, alignment, accent/price color, title & text colors, and button background/text colors — so they always match your brand.

  • 🗺️ Trip Grid — Showcase your trips in a grid or list. Control the number of items, columns (1–4), order (newest, title, price, random, menu order) and filter by destination or activity.
  • 🏨 Hotel Grid — Display your hotels in a grid or list with the same count, columns, ordering and destination-filter controls.
  • 📍 Destinations Grid — Feature your travel destinations in an attractive grid; choose how many to show.
  • 🔎 Travel Search Form — Drop the AJAX search form anywhere in a horizontal or vertical layout.
  • 📝 Booking Form — Embed a booking form for a specific trip/hotel, or let it use the trip/hotel currently being viewed.

⭐ Upgrade to Byteflows Pro

Everything above is free. When you’re ready to sell online and automate your workflow, the Byteflows Travel & Hotel Booking Pro add-on unlocks:

💳 Payments & Checkout

  • Stripe Card Checkout — Accept cards with SCA / 3-D Secure and full server-side verification. No card numbers ever touch your server.
  • PayPal Checkout — Create and capture PayPal orders securely via the REST API.
  • Razorpay Checkout — Take cards, UPI, netbanking and wallet payments with signature verification (ideal for India).
  • Coupons & Discounts — Percentage or fixed-amount codes with usage limits and expiry dates to power your promotions.
  • Pickup Points — Offer free or priced pickup locations that travelers choose at checkout.
  • Printable Invoices — Branded, print-ready invoices for every booking.
  • WhatsApp Notifications — Get instant WhatsApp alerts for new bookings, enquiries and payments, with fully customizable message templates (WhatsApp Cloud API or CallMeBot).

🤖 AI Travel Assistant (bring your own API key)

  • Natural-Language Search — Turn “beach trip under $500 in July” into perfectly filtered results.
  • AI Concierge Chat — A front-end chat widget that answers questions and shows bookable trip/hotel cards.
  • Smart Recommendations — AI-picked related trips and hotels tailored to each visitor.
  • AI Trip Builder & Itinerary Generator — Draft complete trips and day-by-day itineraries from a short prompt.
  • AI-Drafted Customer Replies — One-click reply drafts for booking enquiries, right in the admin.
  • Your Provider, Your Key — Works with OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Groq, Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

🛟 Priority Support — Direct, priority email help from the Byteflows team.

👉 Learn more & get Pro: https://byteflows.net/

💚 Free vs Pro at a Glance

Included free, forever: Trip & hotel management · smart booking engine · advanced search & form builder · wishlist & compare · reviews & ratings · email notifications · booking manager & reports · Gutenberg blocks & Elementor widgets · REST API & schema markup · demo importer · manual / bank-transfer checkout · community support.

Unlocked with Pro: Stripe, PayPal & Razorpay online checkout · coupons & discounts · pickup points · printable invoices · WhatsApp booking alerts · the full AI travel assistant (search, chat, recommendations, trip builder, itinerary generator, drafted replies) · priority email support.

Pro is a separate add-on hosted at byteflows.net. Install it alongside this free plugin and the extra options appear automatically — your trips, hotels, bookings and settings are never touched.

External services

This plugin can connect to the third-party services below. Each is optional and only contacted when you enable and configure the related feature. No data is sent anywhere by default. Demo images are bundled with the plugin — the importer contacts no external service.

OpenStreetMap (only when a trip/hotel has a location map)
Used to display an interactive location map. Map tiles are loaded from the OpenStreetMap tile servers (tile.openstreetmap.org) in the visitor’s browser. The Leaflet map library itself is bundled with the plugin (not loaded externally).
Terms / Tile Usage Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/ — Privacy: https://wiki.osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy

Stripe (Pro add-on only; when the Stripe gateway is enabled and a customer pays by card)
Provided by the Byteflows Travel & Hotel Booking Pro add-on. Used to process card payments. Stripe.js is loaded from js.stripe.com on the checkout page, and the booking amount, currency, order number and a payment token are sent to api.stripe.com to create and verify the charge. No card numbers touch your server.
Terms: https://stripe.com/legal — Privacy: https://stripe.com/privacy

PayPal (Pro add-on only; when the PayPal gateway is enabled and a customer pays with PayPal)
Provided by the Pro add-on. The PayPal JS SDK is loaded from paypal.com on the checkout page, and the booking amount, currency and order reference are sent to PayPal’s REST API (api-m.paypal.com / api-m.sandbox.paypal.com) to create and capture the order.
Terms: https://www.paypal.com/legalhub — Privacy: https://www.paypal.com/privacy

Razorpay (Pro add-on only; when the Razorpay gateway is enabled and a customer pays via Razorpay)
Provided by the Pro add-on. Used to process payments (cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets). The Razorpay Checkout script is loaded from checkout.razorpay.com on the checkout page. The booking amount, currency and order reference are sent to Razorpay’s API (api.razorpay.com) to create an order, and the returned payment id/signature are sent back to verify and capture the payment.
Terms: https://razorpay.com/terms/ — Privacy: https://razorpay.com/privacy/

WhatsApp Cloud API — Meta (Pro add-on only; when WhatsApp notifications are enabled with the Cloud API provider)
Provided by the Pro add-on. Used to send booking/enquiry/payment alert messages to the site owner’s own WhatsApp number. The alert text (booking number, customer name/contact, amount, or enquiry details) is sent to graph.facebook.com using the access token and phone number ID you provide. Opt-in: nothing is sent until you install Pro, enable WhatsApp notifications and enter your credentials. Customers are never messaged.
Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-terms — Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/business-data-privacy

CallMeBot (Pro add-on only; when WhatsApp notifications are enabled with the CallMeBot provider)
Provided by the Pro add-on as an alternative delivery service for the same owner-only WhatsApp alerts. The alert text and your WhatsApp number are sent to api.callmebot.com with the personal API key you obtained from CallMeBot. Opt-in: nothing is sent until you enable the feature and enter your key.
Website & terms: https://www.callmebot.com/

OpenAI (Pro add-on only; when AI features are enabled and OpenAI is the provider)
The AI assistant is part of the Pro add-on. When you or a visitor use an AI feature (search, chat, recommendations, trip/itinerary/reply generation), the relevant query and a short catalogue of your public trips/hotels are sent to api.openai.com using the API key you provide. Opt-in: nothing is sent until you install Pro, enable AI and enter your own key.
Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use — Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Anthropic (Claude) (Pro add-on only; when AI features are enabled and Anthropic is the provider)
Same AI features as above, sent to api.anthropic.com using the API key you provide. Opt-in: nothing is sent until you install Pro, enable AI and enter your own key.
Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms — Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy

Custom / OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Pro add-on only; when AI features are enabled and “Custom” is the provider)
For any OpenAI-compatible API you configure by Base URL (for example Groq at https://api.groq.com/openai/v1, Google Gemini’s OpenAI-compatible endpoint, OpenRouter, or a self-hosted Ollama). The same AI query data described above is sent to the Base URL you enter, using the API key you provide. Opt-in: nothing is sent until you install Pro, enable AI, choose Custom, and enter a Base URL and key. Please review the terms and privacy policy of whichever provider you configure.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it directly from Plugins → Add New in your dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Follow the quick setup wizard, then visit Byteflows Travel → Settings to configure your options.
  4. Import the demo content (optional) and start creating trips and hotels!
sections.faq:
Is Byteflows Travel & Hotel Booking free?

Yes. The complete travel & hotel booking platform — trips, hotels, the booking engine, search, reviews, wishlist & compare, blocks & widgets, the booking manager and manual / bank-transfer checkout — is completely free. Online payments, coupons, invoices, pickup points, WhatsApp alerts and the AI assistant are part of the optional Pro add-on.

Who is this plugin for?

Tour operators, travel agencies, adventure and activity companies, hotels, resorts and anyone who wants to sell trips or rooms directly from their own WordPress website.

Can I take bookings without a payment gateway?

Absolutely. Manual / bank-transfer checkout is built in and works out of the box, so you can start accepting bookings immediately. Stripe, PayPal and Razorpay online checkout are available in the Pro add-on.

Does it work with Gutenberg and Elementor?

Yes. Byteflows includes five native Gutenberg blocks and five matching Elementor widgets — Trip Grid, Hotel Grid, Destinations Grid, Travel Search Form and Booking Form — each with live style controls.

What does the Pro add-on add?

Online payments (Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay), coupons and discount codes, printable invoices, priced pickup points, WhatsApp booking alerts, the full AI travel assistant, and priority support. It installs alongside this free plugin and the extra options appear automatically — nothing to migrate.

How do the AI features work?

The AI assistant is part of Pro and is bring-your-own-key. Enable AI in Settings and enter your provider API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint such as Groq). Nothing is sent to any AI provider until you do this.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. Byteflows uses a clean, responsive design driven entirely by CSS variables, so it adapts to virtually any theme — and you can re-brand colors, fonts and rounding without editing plugin files.

Where do the demo images come from?

The demo importer uses placeholder images bundled inside the plugin. It does not download images from any external service.
